integrity: The facet list is reproduced as finite input. The verification reconstructs the face vector, proves H1 is Z/4 using an index-four determinant certificate plus a surjective mod-four cocycle, and exhausts all three-vertex cliques. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact for the supplied asymmetric 14-vertex L(4,1) triangulation only; no claim is made for all triangulations of L(4,1), for geometric metric systoles, or for global vertex minimality. The 1999 dissertation is earlier but the inspected bibliographic evidence resolves only the year, so the structured day-level date uses the first inspected day-resolved public preprint rather than inventing a 1999 day.
title: All empty triangles are integral one-systoles in Lutz's 14-vertex \(L(4,1)\)
